/**
   * Called by the message copy service to initiate message copying into this
   * folder. This method should NOT be called directly from JS. Instead use
   * `MailServices.copy.copyMessages`.
   *
   * @param srcFolder - Source folder of an operation.
   * @param messages - The array of nsIMsgHdrs in source folder which will be
   *   moved/copied. This must be non-empty.
   * @param isMove - false for copy operation, true for move operation.
   * @param msgWindow - Window for notification callbacks, can be null.
   * @param listener - Listener which receives operation notifications.
   * @param isFolder - Used internally by some implementations.
   * @param allowUndo - Specifies if this operation will be done as an
   *   transaction that can be undone.
   */
  void copyMessages(in nsIMsgFolder srcFolder, in Array<nsIMsgDBHdr> messages,
                    in boolean isMove, in nsIMsgWindow msgWindow,
                    in nsIMsgCopyServiceListener listener, in boolean isFolder,
                    in boolean allowUndo);
